Mumbai Building Fire Kills Two, Injures Six

A fire broke out on the 11th floor of a 12-story residential building in Vile Parle, Mumbai. Two people died and six were injured in the incident. Rescue operations were conducted by the fire brigade. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation. Separately, a landslide in Kurla, Mumbai, reportedly trapped several people.
